microtheory.name: cognitive_behavioral_theory
microtheory.definition: CBT — Beck 1967 + Ellis 1962. Thoughts + emotions + behaviours form a triangle; intervening on any side affects the others. Cognitive distortions (specific patterns of biased thinking) cause + maintain emotional disorders. Most empirically-supported psychotherapy. Substrate analogue: the substrate's drive ensemble + Mt biases + corrections IS the CBT framework — biased cognitions are biased Mt states; behavioural change is ActionSpec re-dispatch; emotional regulation is drive-balance.

concepts.name: cognitive_triad
concepts.definition: Beck. Depression cognitive triad: negative views of self + world + future. Substrate analogue: substrate state where self-Mt + environment-Mt + future-prediction-Mt all carry sustained negative bias.

concepts.name: automatic_thoughts
concepts.definition: Beck. Rapid, involuntary, often distorted thoughts arising in response to events. Operate beneath full awareness. Substrate analogue: substrate's FilterSpec dispatch — automatic, not introspected before firing.

concepts.name: core_beliefs
concepts.definition: Deep, generalised beliefs about self + world ('I am unloved', 'people are dangerous'). Hard to detect, hard to change. Substrate analogue: substrate's foundational frozen Mts.

concepts.name: intermediate_beliefs
concepts.definition: Rules + assumptions linking automatic thoughts to core beliefs ('If I'm not perfect, people won't love me'). Substrate analogue: substrate's covers_failure_modes mappings — links from observation to drive.

concepts.name: behaviour_thought_emotion_triangle
concepts.definition: CBT model: behaviour, thought, emotion interact mutually. Change one → other two change. Substrate analogue: substrate's ActionSpec firing → updates Mt state → updates drive amplitude.

concepts.name: all_or_nothing_thinking
concepts.definition: Beck. Dichotomous categorisation: success/failure, perfect/worthless, with no middle. Substrate analogue: substrate's discrete σ output collapsing continuous gradients.

concepts.name: catastrophising
concepts.definition: Predicting worst-case outcomes; expecting disaster from small problems. Substrate analogue: substrate's anticipation handler amplifying negative ΔF predictions.

concepts.name: fortune_telling
concepts.definition: Predicting future events negatively without evidence. Substrate analogue: substrate's biased predictive model in coherence-drive computation.

concepts.name: mind_reading
concepts.definition: Assuming knowledge of others' thoughts without evidence. Substrate analogue: substrate's other-modelling Mt projecting based on own state.

concepts.name: overgeneralisation
concepts.definition: Drawing global conclusions from single events. 'I failed once, I'll always fail'. Substrate analogue: substrate's wide concept-pattern activation from single instance.

concepts.name: mental_filter
concepts.definition: Selectively attending to negative details while ignoring positives. Substrate analogue: substrate's attention bias toward negative-ΔF events over positive.

concepts.name: disqualifying_positive
concepts.definition: Discounting positive experiences as 'not counting'. Substrate analogue: substrate's negative-bias selectively rejecting positive ΔF.

concepts.name: emotional_reasoning
concepts.definition: Treating feelings as evidence. 'I feel guilty, so I must have done something wrong'. Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-state confused with belief-state.

concepts.name: should_statements
concepts.definition: Rigid rules about how one or others should behave. Produces guilt + anger. Substrate analogue: substrate's frozen rule-Mt creating sustained frustration when reality diverges.

concepts.name: labeling
concepts.definition: Attaching global labels to self or others. 'I am a loser' not 'I made a mistake'. Substrate analogue: substrate's instance-event upgraded to trait-Mt update.

concepts.name: personalisation
concepts.definition: Assuming responsibility for events not under one's control. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-attribution of external causation.

concepts.name: behavioural_activation
concepts.definition: Treatment for depression: schedule + execute reinforcing behaviours despite low motivation. Reverses withdrawal cycle. Substrate analogue: substrate's forced ActionSpec dispatch breaking through low-drive state.

concepts.name: thought_record
concepts.definition: CBT homework: log situation + automatic thought + emotion + evidence-for + evidence-against + balanced thought. Substrate analogue: substrate's event log + post-hoc reasoning + Mt updating.

concepts.name: cognitive_restructuring_technique
concepts.definition: Identify distortion → challenge with evidence → develop balanced thought. Substrate analogue: substrate's derivation_mechanism + ArchitectureCortex assessment + correction.

concepts.name: exposure_response_prevention
concepts.definition: OCD treatment: expose to feared stimulus, prevent the compulsive response. Anxiety habituates. Foa. Substrate analogue: substrate's blocked ActionSpec dispatch under high coherence-drive → drive habituates.

concepts.name: schema_focused_therapy
concepts.definition: Young. Addresses 18 early maladaptive schemas (abandonment, defectiveness, mistrust, etc.). Substrate analogue: substrate's foundational Mts as schemas modifiable through deep correction.

concepts.name: behavioral_experiments
concepts.definition: Test cognitive prediction empirically. 'If I don't check the lock, the house will be robbed' → don't check, observe. Substrate analogue: substrate's curiosity-drive what-if probe.

concepts.name: downward_arrow_technique
concepts.definition: Chain of 'so what?' or 'what would that mean?' to surface core belief from automatic thought. Substrate analogue: substrate's derivation_mechanism walking back from event to underlying Mt.

concepts.name: third_wave_cbt
concepts.definition: ACT, DBT, MBCT, CFT. Emphasises acceptance + present-moment + values + relationship to thoughts (not content). Substrate analogue: substrate's drive-balance + assessment-without-correction passes.

concepts.name: metacognitive_therapy
concepts.definition: Wells. Targets HOW we think about thoughts (rumination, worry, attention) rather than thought content. Substrate analogue: substrate's ArchitectureCortex assessing its own assessment pass.

concepts.name: cognitive_processing_therapy
concepts.definition: Resick. CBT for trauma. Targets 'stuck points' — thoughts blocking trauma processing. Substrate analogue: substrate's frozen-Mt + identity-field interaction in extreme cases.

rules.name: cognitive_distortions_maintain_emotional_disorders
rules.head: the substrate's Mt biases cause sustained negative drive-states
rules.body: the biases must be identified + restructured for substrate function to normalise. Beck 1967. Substrate's derivation_mechanism + correction-firing on biased Mts.

rules.name: thought_change_propagates_to_emotion_and_behaviour
rules.head: the substrate's Mt-state is updated
rules.body: its drive-amplitude + ActionSpec dispatch downstream change in turn. CBT's mutual-influence triangle. Substrate's interconnected Mt + drive + action.

rules.name: core_beliefs_require_repeated_disconfirmation
rules.head: the substrate's foundational frozen Mt is biased
rules.body: single disconfirming events don't update it; sustained repeated disconfirmation across contexts is required. Beck's deep-belief work. Substrate's plasticity_override correction over many cycles.

rules.name: behavioural_experiments_provide_empirical_evidence_against_distortions
rules.head: the substrate holds a predicted-negative outcome
rules.body: the most direct correction is to run the experiment + observe actual outcome. Substrate's curiosity-drive what-if probe replacing assumption.

rules.name: metacognitive_focus_targets_process_not_content
rules.head: the substrate is in a pathological rumination loop
rules.body: addressing 'how am I thinking' (process) is more effective than addressing 'what am I thinking' (content). Wells. Substrate's ArchitectureCortex assessment of its own assess pass.

rules.name: behavioural_activation_breaks_low_drive_state
rules.head: the substrate is in a low-drive depressive state
rules.body: forced ActionSpec dispatch — independent of motivation — restores drive-amplitude through accumulated successful outcomes. Lewinsohn + Jacobson.
